about: Near-future settings test 2026-11-09: GPT only, 6 cases x 2 drawn settings. Drafted by the coding agent (Claude, a closed model by Anthropic). DRAFT. Test pictures only.
world_line_template: Set it in this world, where it fits: a near future, not a fantasy or medieval past; {setting}. Show this world's own version of anything mentioned, like its games, sports, clothes, vehicles and buildings.

A.text: stone-brick houses behind tall trees, tall apartment towers with many windows above the treetops, small drones overhead

B.text: greenery mixed with glass-and-steel buildings with sharp edges

C.text: a chaotic mix of stone, concrete and glass-and-steel buildings, tall and short, some half-built

D.text: people with watches and hand devices, gates with glowing green circles, small robots with screen faces

E.text: a half-kilometre-tall mountain pyramid at the edge of the city

F.text: pine forests, wide grasslands and red mountains with snowy tops

style_mood.label: Mood
style_mood.text: Intense, highly detailed graphic novel look. Moody. Expressive. Dark lines, bold colors. Visible brushstrokes.

style_note: Mood chosen as the least cartoony of the style test: on GPT it paints the scene with visible brushwork, dark detailed light and texture rather than flat cel colour; its pictures there leaned medieval (banners, castles), which this test pushes against.
